instruction: Use VLC to begin streaming the video at this address: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hTWKbfoikeg

metadata.explanation: Variation of VLC streaming task with a different YouTube video URL (Smash Mouth - All Star). Uses the same evaluator pattern (is_vlc_playing with url type). Instruction uses 'begin streaming' phrasing while maintaining the same task structure.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core instruction requirement: VLC is playing the specified YouTube video URL
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) correctly fetches VLC status via HTTP interface and returns the status XML path
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly parses VLC status XML, checks playing state, and validates URL matching
URL matching logic is comprehensive with multiple fallback methods (direct match, filename extraction, domain/path comparison)
Coverage is complete: instruction requires 'begin streaming video at address' and evaluator checks both playing state and URL match
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor concern: YouTube streaming URLs may be transformed by VLC (e.g., to HLS stream URLs or just video titles). The metric has some handling for this (lines 105-125), but runtime testing would confirm if it works reliably for all YouTube streaming scenarios
Consider adding postconfig to re-fetch VLC status if needed, though current setup should work for active streaming

Non-critical: Metric function uses non-standard parameter names (actual_status_path, rule) instead of conventional (result, expected), though this works correctly at runtime since Python uses positional arguments
